items.title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. items.title: The Boring Version of Continual Learning
items.summary: Will Brown of Prime Intellect makes the case that continual learning is about to get boring, in a good way: it is the software development life cycle, applied to models. He traces how agent workflows grow from terminal experiments into production software, why evals should capture the vibe check, and which post-training methods he reaches for, from SFT and on-policy and context distillation to online RL, along with why he is skeptical of jumping straight to OPSD. items.title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
items.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.title: Uber rolls out ChatGPT Work to 30,000+ employees
items.summary: Following a 1,000-person pilot, Uber is bringing ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees worldwide in its first company-wide deployment of an agentic platform for knowledge work. Uber CTO Praveen Neppalli Naga and OpenAI co-founder and President Greg Brockman discuss expanding AI beyond engineering and helping teams rethink entire workflows. Read more about Uber’s rollout of ChatGPT Work: https://openai.com/index/uber-chatgpt-work-rollout/
